adopt: Mint a permit with a spend cap and watch the platform refuse the purchase over it.
description:
Kind: tool

Problem
Platforms block agents even when they identify themselves, because an admitted agent is unbounded: nothing says what it may do, for whom, or who pays when a web page talks it into something.

Install
pip install git+https://github.com/Aitherium/awpermit

Commands
  awpermit

Quick start
  pip install awpermit
synopsis: Let an agent through your door with a scope, a spend cap, and someone accountable.
